claims.originating_goal: Provide public Site documentation and bounded preflight for Interlock/InTr connections so submitting an exact counterparty response packet initiates the existing Universal InTr connection sequence without treating packet submission as authority or connection completion.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release after exact-head Site claim/orchestration, bootstrap, dedicated documentation, and compatibility validation passes and the documentation integration merges. Profile-specific live connection evidence remains separate.
expected_evidence: packet acceptance remains distinct from ingress admission and connection establishment
HIL remains the concrete reference implementation
collision_boundaries: Do not modify HIL profile/runtime semantics owned by existing HIL workstreams
Do not create a second Universal InTr transport or receiver
Do not allow a counterparty packet to assert registered Node or Interlock identity
Do not grant Site, Heartbeat, packet, CI, or transport governance/execution/credential authority
Do not claim CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED without profile-specific authentic downstream evidence
claims.next_task_after_release: Profile-specific adapters, including future MIR connection support, reuse the published response-packet state model and existing Universal InTr transport rather than defining a bespoke transport.
